priority: expand free external testing with four QA-cleared browser games before creating more concepts

games.title: Merge Grid
games.short_description: Swipe matching number tiles together, build bigger values, and chase a higher score before the 4x4 grid locks.
games.description: Merge Grid is a fast number-merging puzzle built for mobile and browser play. Swipe the board or use directional controls to combine equal tiles, build larger values, and keep the 4x4 grid alive as long as possible. It includes local best-score tracking, instant replay, and shareable friend challenges.

games.title: Mini Sudoku Rush
games.short_description: Solve compact 4x4 Sudoku boards against the clock with three lives and a fast replay loop.
games.description: Mini Sudoku Rush turns 4x4 Sudoku into a quick-session score challenge. Fill each row, column, and 2x2 box with 1-4, protect three lives, clear boards for bonus time, and try to beat your previous run. The format is mobile-friendly and built around fast replay and shareable score challenges.

games.title: Dot Compare
games.short_description: Choose the side with more dots before time runs out in a 30-second visual estimation sprint.
games.description: Dot Compare is a 30-second visual estimation challenge. Pick the side with more dots, adapt as the differences become smaller, and build the highest score you can before time expires. Wrong choices cost time, while instant replay and friend challenges keep the loop short and shareable.

games.title: Flood Grid
games.short_description: Flood a 6x6 board with one color before the move limit runs out in this fast color puzzle.
games.description: Flood Grid is a quick color-control puzzle. Start from the top-left region, choose colors to absorb connected tiles, and clear each 6x6 board before the move limit or timer expires. Boards are generated with a solvable path, and the game tracks clears, failures, replays, and shareable score challenges.
